seen.where: https://archives.hungaricana.hu/en/lear/BecsSeg/146425/ (opened in Chrome 9 Nov 2026); AIS archivinformationssystem.at Ungarische Akten records (e.g. ID 3226492 Konvolut A Nadasdysche Aufsaetze, ID 3226836 Konvolut B Miscellanea) are Konvolut-level text records with no item or folio images; Hungaricana BecsSeg records carry no images
seen.extent: fol. 1-2 (one Hungarian letter, probably 2 leaves); proportion of cipher not stated
seen.cipher: Hungaricana record, date of creation '1659.02.07. (?)', description: 'Gróf ? György – ismeretlen személy (orig. magyar, részben sifrír, feloldás nélkül)' (original Hungarian, partly cipher, no decipherment). No leaf seen; no image route exists for this fascicle.

prior_art.decode: Web search (DECODE + Ungarische Akten + Nadasdy/Wesselenyi + 1659 key) found no DECODE record; returned only Hungaricana BecsSeg regests; known.py 'Fasc. 309' hits only this lead.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Web search (Tomokiyo cryptiana + Hungary/Wesselenyi/Nadasdy) found nothing on this letter; cryptiana's Hungarian coverage did not surface.
prior_art.lasry: Web search (Lasry + Habsburg Hungarian cipher) found only Lasry's papal and Maximilian II/Chodkiewicz work; nothing on Hungarian magnate letters of 1659.
prior_art.edition: Searches on the Wesselenyi conspiracy editions (Salgo Agnes, Monumenta Hungariae Historica series) and Hungarian searches for 'sifrirozott level megfejtes' found no edition printing or deciphering Fasc. 309 Konv. A fol. 1-2.
prior_art.literature: Lang Benedek, Real Life Cryptology (2018, open access) covers 300 Hungarian keys and 1,600 letters but the search could not confirm this item; Hungaricana search for Fasc. 309 shows sibling items (1658-60 Nadasdy to Mednyanszky) described without cipher.

2455.key_check: Nadasdy-file key leaf Fasc. 312 Konv. A fol. 4 ('Titkosírás kulcsa', Hungaricana 146641, s.d.) is a different key item in the same files; no image reachable so not tested, and the lead has no known decipherment.
2455.duplicates: known.py 'Fasc. 309', 'Mednyánszky', 'Wesselényi': only this lead and unrelated catalogue entries (Mednyanszky to Kemeny 1655, Mednyanszky to Rakoczi 1655-58, Wesselenyi 1663 Fasc. 310). Same-date letters of Gyorgy and the Mednyanszky circle not found elsewhere. Descriptor 'Graf ? Gyorgy' unidentified.
2455.key_in_volume: Fasc. 312 Konv. A fol. 4, 'Titkosírás kulcsa' (Hungaricana 146641): a key leaf of the Nadasdy papers; not viewed or tested.
